_comment: Interaction step budgets per journey (ADR 0074 pt 3). One entry = the max wrapper interactions (click/fill/press/select) allowed for that journey's spec. Values are the FIRST MEASURED count rounded up by 1 (the ratchet FLOOR) and are the SAME across the whole Playwright viewport matrix (density-dependent panels are pane-sized explicitly, so counts are viewport-independent). They must never exceed the documented ceilings in docs/ux-journeys.md. assertBudget() reddens when a journey grows past its floor (a UX regression) and logs a tighten suggestion when it shrinks. Ceilings for reference: J1 15, J2 25, J3 12, J4 10, J5 6, J6 15, J7 20.
